statement: In the kernel, opening the companion raw-HID client schedules a transition that removes native input registration; IBEX lizard mode is controlled through that interface's settings. SDL periodically requests lizard disable for a connected open joystick and can request IMU settings. These are per-consumer policies, not proof of a kernel-created Puck keyboard or pointer device.

applicability.revision: pinned Linux v7.3-rc1 and SDL 6defbc0 consumer source; retail hardware unmeasured
applicability.scope: Steam Controller 2026 Puck receiver consumer behavior; no physical or virtual host test
